Ranchi Jail Sexual Assault Allegation: ranchi ki hotvar sthit birsa munda kendriy kara (Birsa Munda Central Jail) se jura ek taja aur behad ganbhir mamla samne aaya hai: jel se 12 jun 2026 ko riha hue 20 varshiy ek vicharadhin bandi ke pita ne khelganv thane men ephaaaeeaar darj karaee hai. aarop hai ki jel ke bhitar kuchh kaidiyon ne yuvak ko nashila padarth pilakar tin alag-alag maukon par uske sath samuhik aprakritik yaunachar kiya.
